theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q j : ℕ) (G : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) j) (θ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) j) (N : Set (Eucl P)), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ω → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, θ x = (ω (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → ∀ x ∈ N, exteriorDerivative θ x = ((exteriorDerivative ω) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)
